note: Coherent single charged-pion production by ν_μ/ν̄_μ on the CHARM-II glass (SiO2) calorimeter target, ν_μ N → μ- π+ N (and CC-conjugate for ν̄_μ). HepData record ins358417 provides 10 tables: two energy-binned "total" cross sections (Tables 9,10, model-corrected from visible to total assuming the acceptance region Eπ>5 GeV / P=4 GeV cut, reaction-inclusive over all pion angles), two energy-binned "visible" cross sections restricted to Eπ>5 GeV (Tables 7,8), and 6 single-point (full-run, flux-averaged) cross sections: visible (Tables 1,2) and total corrected with two different extrapolation models — Rein-Sehgal (Tables 3,4) and Belkov-Kopeliovich (Tables 5,6) — one ν_μ/ν̄_μ pair each. No covariance or correlation matrix table is present in this HepData release. Target: SiO2. From the HepData record.
